mechanism: Both agents lower blood glucose through different mechanisms (SGLT2 inhibition vs. metformin-like effects), creating additive hypoglycemic risk; berberine may also increase empagliflozin levels via CYP3A4 inhibition.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely; consider dose adjustment of empagliflozin or berberine; educate patient on hypoglycemia symptoms and counsel on consistent timing and meals with both agents.
